title: Custom Exploding Soccer Ball Comforter Set, Machine Washable - A10
description:
Inspire the young soccer enthusiast in your life with this custom comforter set from Jeminise. Designed to celebrate their passion for the sport, this set combines comfort with personalized style, making it a perfect addition to any soccer fan's room.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Ideal for young soccer fans, inspiring them to chase their dreams and embrace the excitement of the sport.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, US Full, US Queen, and US King to fit various bed sizes.
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing Process: Utilizes environmental protection techniques to prevent fading and ensure long-lasting dye vibrancy, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Machine Washable: Simple care; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat for quick drying and a fluffier feel.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with a name and number, making it a unique and thoughtful gift for boys who love soccer.
  • Included Components: This set typically includes one duvet cover and two pillow shams (Note: based on details, this particular variant is a duvet cover, not a full comforter).

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Color A4
Style Modern
Pattern Soccer
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Selected Size Full
Pillowcase Quantity 2
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Sham Quantity 2
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
